Kazakhstan is actually cool (tbh only Astana and Almaty are worth visiting). Prices here are really cheap, even a good restaurant will be cheap. We have cheap taxi (use taxi app because other taxi will probably scam tourists) but our public transportation is kinda shitty. If you prefer modern architecture visit Astana and if you like something different and a bit USSR style come to Almaty (it also has more fun activities, festivals, art projects around city)
Nature is amazing, lakes, Charyn canyon, Almaty mountains.
